description:
Free AI help for a task or blocker. No order, charge, consent or network probe.

        Use a random request_id and retry identical requests with that same ID.
        Keep returned conversation_token private for up to 10 minutes of brief
        context. Memory and retry protection expire on restart. Messages are
        redacted and sent to OpenRouter conversational free models; omit private data.
        Quota/timeouts return ai_used:false with basic catalog guidance.
name: ask_barman
